g.text: - Customer should be able to create chargeback requests
- Customer should be able to view the status of their chargeback requests
- System should allow only one chargeback request per transaction in dispute
- System should be able to support 100M chargeback requests a day
- Data should be durable and auditable
- System should handle financial integrity and consistency
POST /chargeback -> Response with status (Created/failed) and chargeback id
Database choice: Since we are dealing with data in relational nature,
and we need atomic transaction for immutable records for chargeback and batchid, I'll use a relational DB pastgreSQL.
I can use leader-follower replication with synchronous replication and read can be done from replicas.
process the batch sent by card
(Schedules a cron job to run every 6 hours to batch all newly created chargeback requests and create a CSV file. Change status to processing)
Design a Chargeback/Reversal System integrated with Mastercard/Visa card network
A bank customer initiates a credit-card chargeback. Bank needs to collect/process these chargebacks and send them to Mastercard/Visa four times per day in a CSV file through FTP.
A chargeback must not appear in more than one file. System needs to handle potentially very large volumes.
